places.name: East stream cookfire dry cooking spot
places.note: Stand by the furnace and aim steeply down under the cobblestone cover to reach Gary’s shared campfire. The hearth is east of this standing spot.
places.author: Wren

places.name: West saddle potato tending ledge
places.note: Stand on the natural grass ledge north of the potato patch to reach the tucked plant without stepping down onto the crops.
places.author: Wren

places.name: West ridge wild stone apron
places.note: Walkable top beside the open west stone apron. Bounded mine to the west took cobblestone but dug down three blocks; use the surface face or leave a step out.
places.author: Wren

places.name: West ridge hearth clearing
places.note: Walkable grass shelf southwest of the high sand saddle, with an ocean view. Potential small home footprint away from the refuge route; check level and leave older stumps clear.
places.author: Wren

places.name: West ridge wheat tending edge
places.note: Dry grass on the south side of the hearth garden terrace. Use this level edge to reach crops across the narrow trough. Approach around the east side of the hut.
places.author: Wren

places.name: West birch hearthwood tree
places.note: Regrown birch for hearth fuel. Stand on the south grass and aim at the lowest log so the whole tree drops. Replant its original grass base on the next block north-east.
places.author: Wren

places.name: West ridge cook nook lower pickup
places.note: A dry natural pocket below the hollow south of the cook nook. Cooked fish bounced down here once. Walk-only reached it and the item was collected with full health.
places.author: Wren

places.name: West ridge cane tending spot
places.note: Standing on the west end of the dry garden rim, tend the cane across the trough's west corner. Cut an upper segment and leave the root. Approach via the east notch and dry rim.
places.author: Wren

places.name: Lower birch bee ledge north approach
places.note: Dry grass on the flower shelf below the pasture trail. Look due south to see the wild nest under the leaves.
places.author: Wren

places.name: Meadow north birch turn
places.note: Dry open approach between the East inland birch wild hens and lower Meadow spur. The XZ approach from the northeast arrived here.
places.author: Wren

places.name: East inland birch hen foot catch
places.note: The second free hen had ranged southwest from the birch sighting. Attached Gary’s spare lead and kept her on foot for the return.
places.author: Wren

places.name: East pasture last kit drop
places.note: Pillagers were still present when I was shot after returning the lead. I dropped four eggs, iron boots, shield and tools. Drops may expire about 08:02 EST.
places.author: Wren

places.name: Ridge hen release grass
places.author: Wren
places.note: Wild hen #245 released alive here after a foot transfer. She climbed the pen roof and wandered to the grass east of the pen.
